question: For a two-player Rival Agent turn, what happens to occupied-space cards, empty deck/Reshuffle, space costs/effects, recruitment, deployment and Harvest Spice bonus? What if a two-space card’s applicable option is occupied?
expected_answer: Skip occupied cards until unoccupied; immediately reshuffle empty/Reshuffle; ignore normal costs/effects, only card icons; recruit supply, Combat recruits deploy otherwise garrison; Combat also up to2 garrison even no recruits; bonus harvest spice to bank; applicable option only, if occupied new card not other option.
source_references: Main PDF p19; official FAQ p3 Rivals
observed_answer: If the indicated space is occupied, reveal another card until an eligible unoccupied space appears; on a two-space card, use only the condition-matching option and if occupied draw again, never switch. Reshuffle immediately when the deck empties or Reshuffle appears. Ignore space costs, requirements and effects; resolve only card icons/instructions. Troop icons recruit, deploying to Conflict at Combat spaces; additionally it automatically deploys up to two garrison troops on any Combat-space turn. Harvest Spice chooses the Maker space with most bonus spice, tie-breaks on total base plus bonus, and if none has bonus spice reveals another card; removed bonus spice goes back to bank.

question: Describe ordinary Intrigue privacy and destination, each type’s timing, what happens if the Intrigue deck runs out, and whether playing an Intrigue may avoid its printed cost or condition.
expected_answer: Keep face down separate from deck,may inspect,only reveal on play;Plot own Agent/Reveal,Combat Combat,Endgame gameend;resolve discard faceup beside Intrigue deck,shuffle Intrigue discards if exhausted;must meet conditions/pay cost to play.
source_references: Main PDF p7; official FAQ p2 Intrigue cards
observed_answer: Keep Intrigue cards face down and separate from your deck; you may look at your own at any time and reveal them only when played. Discard played cards face up next to the Intrigue Deck; if it empties, shuffle discards into a new deck. Plot is played on your own Agent or Reveal turn, Combat only during Combat, Endgame only at game end. Intrigue card costs and conditions must be met. The summary does not specify whether other players may inspect your unplayed Intrigue cards.

question: When does Baron Harkonnen choose Masterstroke Factions, how are choices hidden, and how often may they be revealed for Influence?
expected_answer: After all setup before first round choose2of4 tokens facedown on Leader,others box unseen;reveal and gain Influence only once/game as ability describes.
source_references: Main PDF p13; official FAQ p1 Baron
observed_answer: After setup is complete and before the first round, Baron Vladimir Harkonnen secretly chooses two of four Baron tokens and places them Faction-side down on the Leader; return the other two to the box unseen. Reveal later as described to gain the reward, only once per game. The summary does not specify the exact moment or procedure for each later reveal.

question: How do you prepare the humans’ initial decks, the Imperium Row, the Intrigue deck, the Reserve, the Mentat and Alliance tokens, and the initial first player before Round 1?
expected_answer: Each human shuffles their own standard ten-card starting deck and places it face down. Shuffle the Imperium deck and deal five face up to the Row; shuffle Intrigues face down separately. Place Arrakis Liaison, The Spice Must Flow, and Foldspace as three separate Reserve stacks beside the Row. Put the Mentat at its Landsraad space and the four Alliances on their marked Influence-track areas. Randomly choose the initial first player and give that player the marker.

source_references.passages: Setup A1/A2, C1/C2/C3, E and H: Mentat, Alliance tokens, shuffled card decks, five-card Row, three Reserve stacks, shuffled human ten-card decks, random first player.

observed_answer: Each human takes a Leader and color components, shuffles the standard 10-card starting deck and places it face down in supply; place two Agents on Leader and third beside board, set Score and Combat markers, place Influence cubes and troops, give each player 1 water. Put Mentat on its side in its Landsraad space and Alliance tokens on track marks. Shuffle Intrigue deck face down; shuffle Imperium deck face down and deal five face-up Row cards; set Arrakis Liaison, The Spice Must Flow and Foldspace in separate Reserve stacks beside Row. Randomly choose initial First Player and give them the marker. Conflict setup is the separate tiered procedure.

question: For a two-player Rival Agent turn, what happens to occupied-space cards, empty deck/Reshuffle, space costs/effects, recruitment, deployment and Harvest Spice bonus? What if a two-space card’s applicable option is occupied?
expected_answer: Skip occupied cards until unoccupied; immediately reshuffle empty/Reshuffle; ignore normal costs/effects, only card icons; recruit supply, Combat recruits deploy otherwise garrison; Combat also up to2 garrison even no recruits; bonus harvest spice to bank; applicable option only, if occupied new card not other option.
source_references: Main PDF p19; official FAQ p3 Rivals
observed_answer: If indicated space is occupied, reveal another card until eligible. Reshuffle immediately if deck empty or Reshuffle appears; continue revealing. Ignore space costs, requirements, and effects; resolve card icons/instructions. Troop icons recruit, deploying on Combat spaces, otherwise garrison; every Combat visit automatically deploys up to two garrison troops (one if only one). Harvest Spice takes Maker space with most bonus, tie by total base-plus-bonus; if none has bonus, reveal another card. For a two-space card, use only condition-matching option; if occupied, draw again, never switch options.

question: In two-player Combat how does House Hagal get strength and handle rewards/control, including if it wins a space you control? Do human second-place ties pay the third reward even though ordinary third place is unavailable?
expected_answer: If Rival has troop reveal Hagal card at combat start in turn order,reshuffle/reveal if needed; add swords only to troop strength,humans may then Combat Intrigue. No rewards/control; if wins controlled space remove marker. Yes second tie third reward each; ordinary third unavailable in2-player.
source_references: Main PDF pp12,19; official FAQ p1 Conflict
observed_answer: If Hagal has a Conflict troop, at start of Combat reveal Hagal cards until non-Reshuffle; add that card’s swords to 2 per deployed troop, then humans may play Combat Intrigue. Hagal occupies its rank but gets no reward. If it wins a space a human controls, remove that Control marker and Hagal does not replace it. Human tie for second earns third reward; ordinary third earns none.
